snippet.title: Let's Play - Laser Gates (Atari 800/XL/XE)
snippet.description:
Here we have "Laser Gates", the competition currently going on with the Atari 8-bit High Score Club on Atariage.

I have seen other let's play videos and enjoyed them (especially the Bubsy ones), so since I play in the Atari competitions I was hoping to add to their tradition with the Atari side of the house.

This game was played on a Atari 800.
The Music was played on a Dreamcast.
The Music is from the album "Asia:Phoenix" and titled "Sleeping Giant/No Way Back/Reprise" released in 2008.  THANKS ASIA, enjoying the new album.

And enjoy the video!!
